dogecoin.text:
For now I would keep my eyes on Ethereum / $ETH. This will be the catalyst for starting a new leg upwards. Also pay attention to $Doge, which is often an indication for the direction that smaller alts will take.

If you are fully in fiat, wait for trend reversal. Don't be greedy.

Dogecoin is doing more volume than all other altcoins.

Also, $DOGE can serve as a gateway for new crypto market participants.

There is a lot of money to be made with coins like Dogecoin, however, this is only reserved for the minority that knows how to play the market well.

It's easier to simply scale in and out every cycle in Bitcoin and Ethereum. 

Historically guaranteed x20+, without the headache.

The $DOGE investors in profit search for their next investment. The ones that made a loss will revenge trade. 

In any case. They just had a taste of what’s possible and are not ready to leave the cryptocurrency industry, yet.

Elon wants you to sell #Bitcoin and not make it so you don’t have the money to buy Lambos.  

Letting you invest in $DOGE ensures that you have just enough to buy a miniature of a Model 3 Tesla.
